parts.text: 在说明或询问人或物等的存在时可用 there be 结构 。There be 其实是“be there 的倒装”: A girl is there in the classroom. → There is a girl in the classroom. 表客观存在(有)。用于强调、陈述事实或介绍场景。 There be + n.＋介词短语 (出现频率 90%)

rows: There is a girl in the classroom. There is still some honesty in this world. There’s a bus coming, but it’s full. (There be + n. + doing) There is a girl crying in the classroom. (There be + n. + doing + 介词短语) There’s a man at the door. It’s the postman. 用 it 或人称代词作进一步说明
There was a girl in the classroom yestoday . There were some books on the table. There were some people rowing on the river. There were hundreds of people there . There were coins everywhere .

parts.text: it 作为“虚主语”表示时间、距离、天气等概念时，不能用 there be 结构（因为不能还原为 be there）。
It’s fifteen miles to the station.
It is a fine day today .

exercises.q: ___ were some men digging up the road outside my house.
Look at those clouds. I think ___ will be a thunderstorm.
After dinner ___ will be a long discussion on politics.
When will ___ be convenient for you to come?
